mapper.sql: API_NO, API_NM, API_GROUP_CD, HTTP_MTHD_DVCD, REQ_PATH, STTUS_DVCD, DATA_SRC_ID, AUTH_ESSNTL_YN, DOC_DISP_YN, SQL_TEXT, QUERY_TIMEOUT_SEC, DESC_TEXT, REGID AS REG_ID
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM DXAPI_API_DEF_M
( LOWER(API_NO) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{q}) || '%' OR LOWER(API_NM) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{q}) || '%' OR LOWER(REQ_PATH) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{q}) || '%' OR LOWER(API_GROUP_CD) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{q}) || '%' )
AND REGID = #{regId}
ORDER BY API_NO
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DXAPI_API_DEF_M WHERE REGID = #{regId} AND STTUS_DVCD = 'DRAFT'
SELECT PARAM_NM, PARAM_TYPE_DVCD, ESSNTL_YN, BAS_VAL, DESC_TEXT, MASK_RULE_DVCD FROM DXAPI_API_PARAM_M WHERE API_NO = #{apiNo} ORDER BY PARAM_SEQ
SELECT COL_NM, COL_TYPE_DVCD, DISP_NM, MASK_RULE_DVCD FROM DXAPI_API_RESP_M WHERE API_NO = #{apiNo} ORDER BY RSPNS_SEQ
SELECT MAX(API_NO) FROM DXAPI_API_DEF_M WHERE API_NO LIKE #{like}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DXAPI_DATASOURCE_M WHERE DATA_SRC_ID = #{dataSrcId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DXAPI_EXT_SYS_API_MAP_M WHERE API_NO = #{apiNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DXAPI_API_DEF_M (API_NO, API_NM, API_GROUP_CD, HTTP_MTHD_DVCD, REQ_PATH, STTUS_DVCD, DATA_SRC_ID, AUTH_ESSNTL_YN, DOC_DISP_YN, SQL_TEXT, DESC_TEXT, REGID) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{group}, #{method}, #{path}, #{status}, #{dataSrcId}, #{auth}, #{doc}, #{sql}, #{desc}, #{regid})

INSERT INTO DXAPI_API_PARAM_M (API_NO, PARAM_SEQ, PARAM_NM, PARAM_TYPE_DVCD, ESSNTL_YN, BAS_VAL, DESC_TEXT, MASK_RULE_DVCD) VALUES (#{apiNo}, #{seq}, #{name}, #{type}, #{ess}, #{basVal}, #{desc}, #{mask})
INSERT INTO DXAPI_API_RESP_M (API_NO, RSPNS_SEQ, COL_NM, COL_TYPE_DVCD, DISP_NM, MASK_RULE_DVCD) VALUES (#{apiNo}, #{seq}, #{col}, #{type}, #{disp}, #{mask})
